entries.zh: 情愿；出于本心自愿、甘愿
entries.en: to be willing; to consent of one's own will

entries.zh: 投充；自愿投靠、充役依附于人
entries.en: to enter service of one's own accord; to attach oneself as a dependant
entries.notes: 汉栏第二字「克/充」存疑，依音写 chiong 取「充」，与西语 querer 的对应偏弱。

entries.zh: 爱野；贪恋野外（不正当）的游乐
entries.en: to be fond of illicit diversions; to want wanton pleasures

entries.zh: 爱减；想要少些、宁可少取
entries.notes: 音写栏末混入西语 menos，当为原稿照录，不影响义项。

entries.zh: 爱添；想再添加、要求添补
entries.en: to want an addition made; to ask for more to be added
entries.notes: 音写栏混入西语整句 q̃ le añada，当为原稿照录。

entries.zh: 割舍；舍得让出、忍痛给出
entries.en: to be willing to part with; to give up reluctantly

entries.zh: 青草药（草药）；〔四栏义不合，释义存疑〕
entries.en: green herbal medicine; (does not match the Spanish 'to want without justice'; doubtful)
entries.notes: L「不义而求」与 H/M「青草药」语义不合，无法定夺。

entries.zh: 爱用；愿意听用、乐于效劳
entries.en: to be willing to serve; to wish to be employed
entries.notes: 首字「就/訧」存疑；「爱用」取愿受任使之意。

entries.zh: 侵地界；侵占他人地界田产
entries.en: to encroach on another's land boundaries; to covet a neighbour's property

entries.zh: 侵取；侵占夺取他人财物
entries.en: to take by encroachment; to seize another's property

entries.zh: 情愿；同心一意地愿意、一致同意
entries.en: to be of one will; to consent with one accord

entries.notes: 西语残片「q̃ leche」及音写「nay/say」存疑，汉栏仅「乳」，据 queso 释为乳。

entries.zh: 乳饼；鲜奶酪（形如市售之饼）
entries.en: fresh cheese, like the cakes sold; milk cake

entries.zh: 牛乳菓；牛乳所制糕饼、干酪
entries.notes: 第三字「巢/菓」存疑，音写 cuè 近「粿」，姑释为乳制糕。
